name: web-super-cool-title-hero-grey-flowing-line-waves
title: 'Super Cool Title' hero with flowing grey contour-line waves and a minimal top nav
whatItIs: A grey gradient hero with a simple top nav (Home, News, Events, Blog, About, Contact us), a bold left-aligned white headline 'Super Cool Title', body copy, a 'Discover more' pill button, and dense flowing contour-line waves filling the right two-thirds of the background.
whatItMeans: Calm and abstract; dense flowing line waves give a minimal grey hero visual richness without using any colour or photography.
techniques: Fill empty hero space with dense flowing contour lines.
Keep the headline and nav minimal so the line pattern can lead.
Use a subtle pill button that doesn't compete with the background.

vocabulary.definition: A flowing pattern of parallel curved lines.
A hero layout with text anchored to one side rather than centred.
